in_hebrew.name: רִיא
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A name derived from the Hebrew word רֶאשׁ (resheth) meaning head, and עוֹלָה (olah) meaning high, elevated, or mountain. Ree can be interpreted as 'mountain head' or 'head of the mountain.' In the Bible, the name Ree is not found, but it is a valid Hebrew name.

in_greek.name: Ρεέ
